label: Horseshoe-shaped basin north of Cranberry Lake
identity_evidence: Large horseshoe basin south of Murray Lake, west of Crawley Lakes and north of the separate elongated Cranberry basin. The large central land peninsula, short southwestern water arm, northern twin rises and long southeastern arm establish the same water-body definition. Trace the full concave shoreline around the peninsula; do not fill the central land, use a road loop, or include the southern stream and separate Cranberry basin. The area centroid can lie on the central peninsula and is calculated from both full water outlines, not from the printed lake label. Shore generalization, narrow-arm detail and the source western road overlap retain 130 m uncertainty.
phase: Additional fresh central-interior basin check against unchanged affine14; no tuning
